audience: Authenticated partner only; no caller-selected sponsor or tenant.
response: Calendar section with state ready, empty, partial or unavailable; items, notes, observed_at and sources. Each item has start, end, title, location, all_day, schedule_conflict, time_changed and possible_deals. Each possible deal has id, name, client_ref and prep.
preparation: prep.state is ready or unavailable. Ready preparation supplies nullable phase, next_step, next_date, last_touch and market. Missing preparation never hides the meeting or its possible deal link.
match_basis: Exact attendee email is a possible match, never a confirmed meeting-to-deal relationship. Display suggestions as unconfirmed. Failed deal_suggestions is unavailable, never proof of no related deal.
presentation: On-demand Home dialog. Render calendar notes including zero-row partial responses, source freshness, unavailable states and retry. No startup read or writes. Clear content and reject late results on close, disposal or session invalidation.
